query:
SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables 
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() 
AND table_name LIKE '%visit%' OR table_name LIKE '%analytic%' OR table_name LIKE '%pageview%' OR table_name LIKE '%traffic%' OR table_name LIKE '%session%'
ORDER BY table_name;
